retention.PA-NS: Nanospace requirements/dependencies combine with Boan mission/energy continuity and separate credibility methods. HTN planning integration, method admission and required platform adapters are proposed additions.
retention.PA-GY: SeaLion YAML/Git records combine with CSRM patterns, concept sizing and developing industrial FMI methods. EPS semantics, method guidance, required platform adapters and human authority controls are proposed additions.
retention.PA-CDT: The user custom enriches native SysML v2/CSRM requirements and parametrics. Jev recommends analyses and V&V, engineers decide eligibility/acceptance, Python implements/orchestrates calculations and a maintained COTS database supplies engineering data. These are proposed custom enrichments.

retention.PA-COM: Retain: published parameter ownership, catalogues and Excel budget work remain useful. Complete requirement semantics, dynamic analysis, active assistance and exact releases are proposed additions.
retention.PA-NS: Retain: concurrent parameter sharing and dependency analysis remain distinct strengths. Integrated Nanospace/HyperTension planning is prospective. Gaphor extraction is a separate tool-specific profile, never assumed to transfer automatically.
retention.PA-VS: Retain and reopen: demonstrated preliminary tree/mode/budget transfer is relevant. It establishes neither complete EPS readiness nor qualified assistance. Prior preference is replaced by this current comparison with unresolved service access and synchronization.
retention.PA-CDT: Retain and refine: native model/Python core gives explicit local semantic authority and replaceable specialist profiles. CSRM is a source of structural patterns, not proof of a SysML v2 EPS library or migration. No mandatory scene profile is inherited.
retention.PA-GY: Retain: portable reviewable text is a distinct authoring choice. Source prototypes exclude requirement/test management, so all engineering semantics, assistance and evidence controls are proposed additions. Git alone supplies no approval or engineering meaning.
